description: Research dated flights and hotel stays with source price bases, complete itineraries and comparable quote snapshots.

env_var_specs.name: TRAVELOKA_SESSION_FILE
env_var_specs.description: Path to a private Traveloka-only cookie and request-profile session file. This is a file path, never a raw Cookie header.

novel_features.name: Explicit flight date grid
novel_features.description: Compare retrieved trip totals across a bounded list of explicit departure and return dates.

novel_features.name: Explicit hotel stay grid
novel_features.description: Compare source stay totals for one property across equal-length stays with fixed occupancy.

novel_features.name: Flight trade-off frontier
novel_features.description: Keep retrieved flight offers that trade price against stops and elapsed time.

novel_features.name: Same-room cancellation price difference
novel_features.description: See the stay-price difference between comparable cancellable and nonrefundable room rates.

novel_features.name: Quote snapshot changes
novel_features.description: Compare matched-offer price and policy changes between two explicit retrieval snapshots.
